svm: 0.7587 but requires scaling and sensitive to kernel choice

models.scale_reason: effectively required - linear models are sensitive to feature scales

models.reason: Second in shortlist (0.7649), complementary linear bias, interpretable coefficients, handles class imbalance through weighting.

validation.reason: Rows are independent (no detected entity groups). 5-fold stratified CV balances rare class representation (~1,493 'yes' per fold). K-fold provides stability for hyperparameter selection with imbalanced data.
alternatives_considered: holdout: simpler but single estimate less stable for rare class
3-fold: fewer folds but larger per-fold rare count (~2,488)

tuning.reason: Class imbalance (3.2:1 ratio) makes f1_macro more appropriate than accuracy.
tuning.final_fit_reason: With kfold validation, all non-test data is seen exactly once during validation, so using pool maximizes training data.
alternatives_considered: precision: focuses on positive predictions but ignores recall

primary_metric.name: f1_macro
primary_metric.reason: Critical to balance precision and recall for minority class 'yes' in imbalanced dataset.
primary_metric.rejected_reason: Accuracy misleading with 76% majority class; could achieve 76% by always predicting 'no'.

report.dataset_label: IN6227 Classification Dataset - train.csv (31,112 rows) / test.csv (13,334 rows)

narrative.candidate_models: Screen tested 7 families on 15,000 subsampled rows. Shortlist by f1_macro: gradient_boosting (0.7665 ±0.0053) and logistic_regression (0.7649 ±0.0054). These represent complementary biases: axis-aligned staircase vs. linear decision boundaries. Eliminated: svm (0.7587), random_forest (0.7572), knn (0.7469), decision_tree (0.6956), naive_bayes (0.6631).
narrative.feature_engineering: No engineered features. 7 numeric features standardized for linear models; 8 categorical features one-hot encoded (82 columns total). High-cardinality 'region' (21 categories) handled via encoding.

cleaning_why.why: Cannot train or validate without known label
Impute inside folds to prevent data leakage

narrative.validation_argument: Rows are independent (no detected entity groups). 5-fold stratified CV balances rare class representation (≈1,493 'yes' per fold vs. ≈4,742 'yes' in holdout). K-fold provides stability estimate for hyperparameter selection with imbalanced data.
narrative.primary_metric_argument: Task: predict 'yes' class (24%). Classes uneven (3.2:1). Error cost: false negatives likely more costly than false positives. Validation supports macro-averaging. f1_macro weights both classes equally.
narrative.performance_comparison: Gradient boosting expected to capture complex interactions; logistic regression offers linear transparency. Key difference: gradient_boosting may better handle feature interactions; logistic regression may be more stable with limited data.
narrative.limitations: Test set provided as separate file, not used for validation. 'yes' class size (7,464) supports 5-fold CV but leaves thin per-fold estimates. High-dimensional one-hot encoding (82 columns) may introduce sparsity. No cross-validation on test set, so generalization estimate limited to provided test split.
